name: ModelVariant138_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant138_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a 13x13 rainbow grid of Gouraud-shaded quads waves and scrolls in front of the slot while the model's ambient light dims; a rainbow-shaded ring then sways and bounces with 34 colour-cycling sprites orbiting it, 32 sprites rise from around the opposing slot, and the light is restored at the end); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the grid, ring and sprites and packs three texture words from one image, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 during the lead-in, 2 once the fade has ended and the light is restored, 1 once when the ring's cycle completes, 4 while it runs and 0 after the completion; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-155 and 285 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
